plain_english_policy: This bill directs that if the Governor declares a proration in the state education trust fund budget, all remaining proceeds from Etowah County's sales and use tax (specifically the portion allocated to school systems) may be used exclusively to pay salaries of certified personnel at local schools and Gadsden State Community College. Normally, these funds are restricted to construction, maintenance, equipment, or supplies.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would authorize Etowah County officials to redirect sales tax revenue intended for capital projects (construction/maintenance) directly toward paying teacher salaries during times of state budget proration, ensuring school staff remain paid despite reduced state funding. This creates a contingency mechanism where local taxes fill the gap left by state cuts specifically for personnel costs.
sponsorship_supports_position: Senator Means (N & P) advanced this bill to provide financial stability for school districts during budget proration events.
evidence_quotes: "should the Governor declare proration in the state education trust fund budget, all of the remaining proceeds may be used to pay the salaries of the certified personnel of the school systems or Gadsden State Community College."
"This discretion only exists when the education trust fund budget is in proration."
